task.description: Independently re-verify ORCH's CI warning fix on commit 277b9f4c (removal of unused `overrides \\ %{}` default from private helper `valid_definition/1` in test/letflow/entities/record/projector_test.exs, addressing the ISS-0069-class warning-detection gate failure from mix letflow.check.test).

result.note: Verified independently: (1) `git show HEAD` confirms the diff is exactly the one-line change `defp valid_definition(overrides \\ %{}) do` -> `defp valid_definition(overrides) do` in test/letflow/entities/record/projector_test.exs, nothing else. (2) `git diff --stat HEAD~1..HEAD` confirms only that one file changed, 1 insertion/1 deletion. (3) grep of the file shows valid_definition/1 has exactly one call site (line 126, `valid_definition(overrides)`), always with an explicit argument -- the removed default was genuinely dead, not papering over a real zero-arg call elsewhere in this file (unlike the analogous helper in definitions_test.exs/records_test.exs, which is correctly left with its default). (4) `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` -- clean, no output/warnings. (5) `mix format --check-formatted` -- clean, no output. (6) `mix test test/letflow/entities/record/projector_test.exs` -- Result: 10 passed, 0 failures. (7) `git status --short` -- clean working tree, no other changes. All checks confirm the fix is correct and minimal. PASS.
